name: Fender
detail: Artist pricing on gear: two electric guitars and a bass had been ordered through it by May 2010. The band also had an official Fender artist page (artist id 314 on fender.com). In November 2009 the band wrote that it had bought three guitars from Fender.

name: Electro-Voice (EV)
detail: Free microphones as needed, and artist pricing on PA gear.

name: SJC Drums
detail: Kevin Hammond's drum kit with the band's logo (visible in the photo archive). Still described as an endorsement in February 2011.

name: Skelanimals
detail: Free shirts and paid photoshoots; talk of magazine ads and of a limited-run album figurine with a flash drive inside, which Fearless agreed to explore. The band was also made a sponsor of Skelanimals' new company, so so happy.

name: Umbrella Clothing
detail: Free clothing and magazine ad offers from a friend's small company; offers to buy scrims and sponsor a Warped Tour tent.

name: HK Army
detail: Free clothing and discounted tour-bus rentals.

name: Aguilar Bass Amplification
detail: Artist pricing; the bassist bought a bass head from them.

name: Eloquent Creative
detail: Custom road cases in military-grade purple with the Let's Get It logo stencilled on.

name: Rocksmith Tokyo
detail: Streetwear company; Joe Gilford was its Ohio representative and it offered free clothing.

name: Ernie Ball
detail: Set up by Christian Coffey of The Collective: discounted strings, and the Ernie Ball logo added to the band's sponsors page.

name: ZZYZX Snap Jack (Jodavi, Inc.)
detail: Cable endorsement agreement signed by Christopher Lairmore, Tyler Smyth and Taylor Foiles.

name: Crunk Energy Drink
detail: Its logo appears on the Get Money Tour poster.

name: Hot Topic
detail: Sold a Let's Get It t-shirt; the band performed at a Hot Topic store on 2010-07-18 (fan listing plus band-channel video).

name: Offers not taken up (as far as known)
detail: Inkdt guitar skins (May 2011) and Epyon Royal Apparel (September 2011) offered endorsements by email.
